column1: # GOLDEN2-LIKE paralogs used in the photosynthesis figure (fig_photo_etc,
# panels C and D) of the BioFlux manuscript.
# arabidopsis_gene / arabidopsis_name / psi / tag record the PlantSEED ortholog
# call. tag O means OrthoFinder called the pair orthologous, which is accepted
# regardless of identity -- note all four PSI values fall below the monocot
# (0.55) and eudicot (0.60) thresholds, so none would have been accepted on
# identity alone.
# paper_label is the name the manuscript uses, and for Sorghum it deliberately
# does NOT follow the Arabidopsis assignment. The slots were swapped on
# 2026-08-04 so that SbGLK1 is the gene in the grass GLK1 clade
# (Sobic.010G096300, which clusters with rice Os06g24070).
# Why the two numberings disagree: the grass GLK1 clade does not share its most
# recent common ancestor with Arabidopsis GLK1. It shares it with Arabidopsis
# GLK2. The rows below are that result -- AT5G44190 (AtGLK2) is the exclusive
# Arabidopsis match of Sobic.010G096300, the grass GLK1-clade gene, while
# AT2G20570 (AtGLK1) matches Sobic.003G002600. So a label taken from the
# Arabidopsis best hit calls the grass GLK1-clade gene "GLK2", inverting it
# against the grass literature.
# The digits are crossed because GLK1 and GLK2 were numbered independently in
# the two lineages -- in Arabidopsis, and in the grasses via maize G2/ZmGLK1 and
# rice OsGLK1/OsGLK2 -- before the relationships across the monocot/eudicot split
# were resolved. The numbers are historical nomenclature, not a claim of
# orthology, and they do not correspond between lineages.
# The manuscript follows the grass numbering because the C3/C4
# sub-functionalization argument (Wang et al., 2012) is about the grass clades:
# it is the bundle-sheath/mesophyll-compartmentalized grass GLK1 that the
# Pearson r of +0.86 in the text refers to.
# Poplar's two copies are an indistinguishable recent Salicaceae whole-genome
# duplication pair and cannot be separated into GLK1 and GLK2, so the manuscript
# labels them A and B.
# Authoritative source for the mapping: CONFIG.glk_orthologs in
# Paper_Figures/fig_photo_etc.py of the companion gradient-descent repository.
